context:
Use typing.Protocol (PEP 544) for structural typing - no inheritance changes
to existing dataframe libraries. Mark with @runtime_checkable so the
conformance test can use isinstance().

For methods that genuinely vary across backends (e.g., Polars lazy vs Pandas
eager), keep the library-specific type at the dispatch site and document why.

Be honest about Any: if a method genuinely takes "anything that has __array__",
keep Any with a one-line comment explaining why a more specific type is wrong.
The goal is not zero Any; it is meaningful Any.
description:
Quality plan Phase 4b. The audit found 6,059 `Any` annotations across
benchbox/, concentrated in the dataframe interop layer
(benchbox/platforms/dataframe/unified_frame.py: 4,138 lines). This is the
largest single source of typing evasion in the project. The 190 `# type: ignore`
directives cluster in the same area.

Define a DataFrameProtocol capturing the common surface across Polars,
Pandas, PyArrow, Modin, Dask, cudf - operations actually used by BenchBox
(read_parquet, filter, group_by/agg, join, collect, schema, len). Replace
Any annotations with the protocol where dispatch is generic, and with
concrete library types where dispatch is library-specific.

anti_patterns.dont: add runtime type checks at every call site

anti_patterns.why: dataframe libraries don't share one and we can't modify them

preserves.behavior: All dataframe-platform tests pass on Polars, Pandas, PyArrow at minimum
Lazy-loading semantics for optional dataframe backends preserved
Runtime behavior of unified_frame.py unchanged - this is type annotations only (plus protocol definition)

verifications.command: uv run ty check benchbox/platforms/dataframe/ > /tmp/ty_after.txt; diff /tmp/ty_baseline.txt /tmp/ty_after.txt | grep '^>' || true
verifications.description: Type checker shows no new errors on dataframe layer vs pre-refactor baseline captured in w1
verifications.expected: no lines emitted (additions to baseline = new errors; removals are tolerated and filtered out)

verifications.description: Protocol conformance test passes for every backend

work_units.summary: Capture ty-check baseline to /tmp/ty_baseline.txt, then classify unified_frame.py methods: generic dispatch → protocol, library-specific → concrete type, escape hatch → keep Any
Define benchbox/platforms/dataframe/protocol.py with DataFrameProtocol covering the common surface (use typing.Protocol + runtime_checkable)
Replace Any annotations in unified_frame.py per the survey classification
Run `uv run ty check benchbox/platforms/dataframe/` - fix any newly-surfaced errors (these are real bugs the prior Any was hiding)
Add a regression test that asserts DataFrameProtocol satisfies isinstance() check for each supported backend
